explanation: States W(3,7) = 46. This matches the exact value in Ahmed–Kullmann–Snevily (2014) and OEIS A007783 (w(n,3;2) data: …, 46, …). W(k,r) is defined as the sInf of N such that every 2-colouring of {1..N} has a colour-0 k-AP or a colour-1 r-AP. IsAPOfLength requires the AP set to have exactly the stated cardinality, so the difference is nonzero. This matches Green's definition.
